# Vendored: difit

- Upstream: https://github.com/yoshiko-pg/difit (MIT)
- Vendored commit: `bc9ebc360c30a3020c14f1b733ceb82c1b665e48`
- Local path: `../../difit` (sibling checkout used for the copy)

## What was copied

- `src/` (wholesale, minus `src/site/` — the GitHub Pages docs site, not needed)
- `public/` (minus `public/site-data/`, generated by the docs site build)
- `vite.config.ts`, `postcss.config.js`, `tsconfig.json`, `tsconfig.cli.json`
- `vitest.config.ts`, `vitest.setup.ts`, `vitest.env.stub.ts`
- `LICENSE`

This is a hard fork: upstream difit updates will not merge cleanly, and that's
accepted per SPEC.md. Modify in place; log every change below.

## Local modifications

| Date | File | Why |
|------|------|-----|
| 2026-07-27 | `package.json` (new) | difit's `src/cli/index.ts` imports `../../package.json` for the version string; added a minimal `{name, version, private, type: "module"}` file so that import resolves and so Vite doesn't warn about untyped ESM/CJS detection for `postcss.config.js`. |

No changes to any file under `src/` yet — M1 gate was to get the vendored copy
building and serving unmodified. Route namespacing, SQLite-backed comments,
and the Full File view will be layered on top starting in M2+ and logged here
as they land.

## Root-level dependency additions

difit's own `package.json` (in the sibling checkout, not copied here) lists
its runtime/dev dependencies; the top-level `cmux-localreview/package.json`
mirrors all of them (needed since `vendor/difit/` has no `node_modules` of its
own — it shares the workspace root's).
